perturbation_pairs.method: sharp microelectrode (~70 MOhm, 3 M KCl), current clamp
perturbation_pairs.citation: Sempou E, Kostiuk V, Zhu J, et al. Membrane potential drives the exit from pluripotency and cell fate commitment via calcium and mTOR. Nature Communications 13:6681, 2022
perturbation_pairs.mapping_assumption: kcnh6 encodes an ether-a-go-go voltage-gated K+ channel. Our channel set has no EAG. K_leak is used as the generic non-rectifying K+ conductance, in preference to Kir which is specifically inward-rectifying. Knockdown is modelled as complete loss, which overstates a morpholino's typically partial knockdown; the predicted depolarization should therefore be an UPPER bound on what a morpholino would produce.

perturbation_pairs.citation: Wang W, Dietl P, Silbernagl S, Oberleithner H.
perturbation_pairs.mapping_assumption: Ba2+ is the canonical Kir blocker, so this maps onto our Kir column directly. 1 mM Ba2+ is a strong but not necessarily complete block; modelled as complete.

perturbation_pairs.citation: Hyde D, Baldrick P, Marshall SL, Anstee JH.
perturbation_pairs.mapping_assumption: RETAINED DELIBERATELY AS A COUNTEREXAMPLE. The same reagent and nominal target as barium_frog_kidney, but the measured shift has the OPPOSITE SIGN (hyperpolarization). Insect Malpighian tubules are driven by an apical V-ATPase, which our parameterization holds at zero, so the tissue's dominant electrogenic pump is absent from the model. No channel-density mapping can reproduce this, and the model is expected to fail on it. Including it is the point: it shows that 'block a K+ channel' is not a tissue-independent operation.

perturbation_pairs.citation: Van de Sande DV, Kopljar I, Alaerts M, et al. Channels, 2021
perturbation_pairs.mapping_assumption: UNCONSTRAINED SCALE FACTOR. Carbenoxolone at 100 uM is a partial uncoupler, but the fraction of junctional conductance remaining is not reported. 0.5 is a placeholder chosen only so the dose ordering (100 uM < 200 uM) is preserved. The MAGNITUDE of this prediction is therefore not a test; only the SIGN and the ordering relative to the 200 uM record are.

perturbation_pairs.citation: Van de Sande DV, Kopljar I, Alaerts M, et al. Channels, 2021
perturbation_pairs.mapping_assumption: Same caveat as the 100 uM record: 0.2 is a placeholder. The testable content is that a stronger uncoupling should depolarize MORE than the weaker one.

perturbation_pairs.tissue: cardiomyocyte, monolayer versus isolated single cell
perturbation_pairs.citation: Van de Sande DV, Kopljar I, Alaerts M, et al. Channels, 2021
perturbation_pairs.mapping_assumption: Complete uncoupling, so unlike the carbenoxolone records the scale factor is not a free parameter. This is the cleanest gap-junction test available and it is the one that most directly probes the graph term. Caveat: isolation removes coupling but also changes the mechanical and paracrine environment, so not all of the 18.8 mV need be electrical.
